description: This file defines a development-only helper function for simulating project cost history data in a local development environment. It includes checks to disable its execution in production, introduces a delay, and returns mock data related to project costs.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Asynchronous function that simulates fetching project cost history. Throws an error if called in production environment, otherwise waits for 300ms and returns mock data for a given project ID.
